events.text: Persia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of Plenty (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food in every city and 20% faster border growth)

Denmark has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
The Aztecs have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Spirit Animals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each Horse, [ICON_RES_DEER] Deer, and [ICON_RES_BISON] Bison resource)

Babylon has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Vine (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_RES_WINE] Wine, [ICON_RES_BEER] Beer, and [ICON_RES_COGNAC] Cognac resource)

Carthage has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Seafood Rituals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each source of [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crabs, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CAVIAR] Black Caviar and [ICON_RES_REDCAVIAR] Red Caviar. +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from each source of [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish)
